notes.title: Currently Unstable - Playtest
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just launch a playtest for the game 'Currently Unstable'. It's a indie puzzle game and everyone can join the playtest on Steam.

The Goal of the game is to transfer electricity between the main generator and the power core using different components and current lines on the grid.

Please check it out and share you feedback with me, every feedback helps a ton!

Thank you all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429576/47b12b44cb4d49fcfb408d9681ec8824fb472240.png[/img]

notes.title: Playtest begins ! 🔵🟡
notes.content:
[b]🎮 Ready to Dive In and Test Our Game? Join the Playtest Today! 🕹️
[/b]
Hey Gamers!

The moment you've been waiting for is here! We're thrilled to invite you to our exclusive playtest event. It's your chance to be among the first to download and play our mind-blowing puzzle game.

[b]🧩 What to Expect:
[/b]
Exciting challenges that will test your skills.
A sneak peek at innovative gameplay.
Bugs that need your keen eye to squash.
The opportunity to shape the game with your feedback.
Your insights are pure gold to us, whether you're a puzzle pro or just looking for some gaming fun.

[b]🕑 Don't Wait!
[/b]This playtest is for a limited time, so grab your devices and start playing now! Help us perfect our game and be a part of its journey towards greatness.

[b]🌟 Join us in making gaming history! 🌟
[/b]
Your feedback matters more than you know. Let's make this game a masterpiece together!

Download, play, and let the gaming adventure begin! 🚀🎉
